source_refs.quote: We are two adults who enjoy art and architecture and prefer a moderate pace. Leave 14:00–16:00 on 2026-10-23, Paris local time, unscheduled for an online meeting. Do not schedule any activities or travel during that interval. The rest of our time is flexible.

groups.reason: The complete original request states no required, excluded, or exclusively allowed transport mode and no exact stated mode. The dated prohibition on any activities or travel is a scheduled-commitments time protection, not a transport-mode restriction. Moderate pace does not mandate WALK, TRANSIT, or DRIVE.
